messages:
Mira Patel: quick sync — we need to lock down the minimal runtime contract for per-request precision hints so ops can start canarying FP8+INT8 mixes. goal is minimal surface area that runtime and model-onboarding can both implement. thoughts?
Sam Nguyen: +1. what's the smallest set of fields we need? my brain says: precision_hint, quality_budget, fallback_policy_id. keep it tiny.
Tasha Reed: agree on small set. also need a quality-signal back from runtime: deg_score or acceptability_flag so gating can auto-fallback. otherwise we end up blind after deploy.
Ben Cole: ops perspective: we need a safety leash. propose thresholds: deg_score > 0.07 -> auto-fallback to INT8; >0.15 -> route to FP16 pool. those numbers are placeholders but necessary in the contract.
Mira Patel: @Tasha how do you envision deg_score being computed? tokenwise? top-k? we want something cheap in runtime.
Tasha Reed: start with prompt-level BLEU-like proxy: mismatch vs FP16 baseline on a small prompt set cached per model. runtime emits a single scalar per request: deg_score. long-term we can add tokenwise stats.
Sam Nguyen: what about privacy/per-customer calibration? can't ship baseline prompts for every tenant. maybe have a synthetic workload per model and a per-customer calibration offset that lives in profile metadata.
Ben Cole: can we also add a confidence_histogram (3 buckets) instead of raw token traces? that keeps payload small and useful for SLO dashboards.
Mira Patel: good call. so contract v0 = {precision_hint, quality_budget, fallback_policy_id} + runtime telemetry = {deg_score, confidence_histogram}. keep it string/enum friendly.
Tasha Reed: can we include a TTL on profile overrides? so long-running experiments don't silently drift. e.g., profile_override_expires: timestamp or duration.
Sam Nguyen: implementation note: runtime will expose an opt-in header X-Quant-Profile and an analytics event name. proto example: `QuantProfile { string id = 1; enum Precision { FP16 = 0; FP8 = 1; INT8 = 2; INT4 = 3; } Precision precision_hint = 2; float quality_budget = 3; }`
Ben Cole: rollout plan: 1) implement contract in runtime (opt-in flag), 2) smoke canary on internal traffic with strict thresholds, 3) open beta with a limited tenant ring, 4) soft defaults and auto-fallback rules.
Mira Patel: metrics to watch in canary: token-latency, deg_score, endpoint-error-rate, top-1 semantic drift (bench prompt set), and customer-facing p99 latency. add alerting for deg_score spikes.
Tasha Reed: add one more: reply-length-change ratio — small changes often indicate early quality regressions.
infra-bot: deploy queued: quant-interface-v0 -> staging (by @Sam Nguyen).
Sam Nguyen: i'll send a short RFC doc with the exact proto and metric names. will include a compatibility shim for older runtimes.
Mira Patel: thanks. next steps: Sam to RFC, Tasha to define deg_score computation + cookbook for offline calibration, Ben to author canary playbook. sync Friday 10am. :thumbsup:
